title: Continuity of the Gaussian torus map
statement: For each natural number $n$, the map from $\mathbb R^n$ to the product torus indexed by $\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\}$ that sends $x$ to the coordinates represented by $x_i$ and $\sqrt{2}x_i$ modulo $1$ is continuous.
